_comment: Allowlist of VES correspondence letterTemplate.formNumber values relevant to the CHAMPVA Status Tool (BE: Finalize VES CCL Letter Filtering, ticket #152149). This is the source of truth, not a prefix allowlist -- a CG/CCL/CVA prefix alone does not make a letter relevant (CG in particular can include correspondence outside CHAMPVA scope entirely). Matching (see IvcChampva::ChampvaLetterAllowlist) drops any suffix VES appends after a literal '.' (e.g. '.ENC') and a single trailing lowercase letter -- a version indicator (e.g. 'CG-A01a' today, a future 'CG-A01b' tomorrow) rather than part of the letter's identity -- before comparing, so this list does not need updating for every new version VES introduces. Update this list only with confirmation from Product/content per the ticket.
